rules: Read and authenticate all seven pinned complete bodies before parsing
Use report_faults group order only after proving observed full uncollapsed enumeration and pinned same-state provenance
Match complete report/native/basic/canonical keysets and every native class; reject duplicates and unknown/orphan EQ
Do not require representative and equivalent members to share polarity
Accept only frozen strict DS/DI detector classes; exclude PD/PT, AU, UC, UO, UU and all non-detected groups
Reconcile every expanded top class with statistics, not only DS+DI or grand total
Map detected members to canonical keys and produce deterministic full-set and group-relation hashes
Keep actual fault_mode setting unobserved unless explicitly evidenced; no default assumption
No EQ grouping inferred from arbitrary MTFI adjacency or cross-Instance order
final_seal_requires: No runtime/cycles/model acceleration claims from this coverage proof
